items.title: Derive validation lock identity from a canonical shared root
items.context: Replace validationExecutionLockPath join(root, ...) with a lock root resolved from the git common dir or canonical metadata root so all worktrees and hosts of the same story share one lock.
items.userSees: validationExecutionLockPath returns the same lock path for two different worktree roots of the same story.

happy.desc: validationExecutionLockPath resolves to the same lock path for two different worktree roots of the same story.

edge.desc: non-git project falls back to projectRoot lock without throwing.

adversarial.desc: different storyIds still get different locks; plain repo unchanged.

verificationEvidence.note: worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f, post F-005/F-006/F-007 fix (commit f39ef9f967); covers validationExecutionLockPath cross-worktree lock identity.
worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; non-git dir falls back to root lock path without throwing.
worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; different storyIds still get different locks, plain repo unchanged.

items.title: Digest a repo-relative logical cwd with versioned receipt-envelope migration
items.context: Change buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope to digest a repo-root-relative logical cwd (physical workspace recorded separately as provenance), bump the envelope schemaVersion, and accept old-shape receipts during migration.
items.userSees: buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope produces the same digest for the same logical command under two different worktree roots; legacy receipts still verify.

happy.desc: buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope produces the same digest for the same logical command under two different worktree roots.

edge.desc: legacy old-shape receipt still verifies under the versioned migration.

adversarial.desc: genuinely different commands still digest differently.

verificationEvidence.note: worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope digests identically for the same logical command under two worktree roots (schema v2).
worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; legacy schema v1 absolute-cwd receipt still verifies under validateCommandSpecDigestCoverage migration.
worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; genuinely different commands digest differently, plus F-002 isolation check (only cwd varies) digest differs.

items.title: Record the resolved physical workspace path as non-digested provenance
items.context: When the command-spec digest switches to a repo-relative logical cwd (CHK-002), the resolved absolute/physical workspace path must still be recorded in the envelope as a separate, NON-digested provenance field, so operators can see where a command actually ran without the physical path affecting cross-host digest equality.
items.userSees: The command-spec envelope carries the resolved physical cwd as a provenance field that is NOT part of the digest; two roots produce the same digest but each records its own physical provenance.

happy.desc: the command-spec envelope records the resolved physical cwd as a provenance field that is excluded from the digest.

edge.desc: two different physical roots yield the same digest but different provenance values.

adversarial.desc: altering only the provenance field does not change the digest; altering the logical cwd does.

verificationEvidence.note: worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; envelope.resolvedCwd records the resolved absolute physical workspace path per root.
worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; two different physical roots (mainRoot vs worktreeRoot) yield the same digest but different resolvedCwd provenance values.

worktree-portability smoke (25 checks, exit 0) at fix HEAD 2206d4f; resolvedCwd differs while digest stays equal (provenance excluded from digest), and F-002 shows altering the logical cwd changes the digest.
